class.name: IfcRelAssignsToGroupByFactor
class.brief_description: The objectified relationship IfcRelAssignsToGroupByFactor is a specialization of the general grouping mechanism. It allows to add a factor to define the ratio that applies to the assignment of object definitions (individual object occurrences as subtypes of IfcObject and object types as subtypes of IfcTypeObject ) to a group (subtypes of IfcGroup ). members.member: Factor provided as a ratio measure that identifies the fraction or weighted factor that applies to the group assignment.
